keyFindings.description:
The canonical sentence is pinned by no test, so the contradiction this change removes can be reintroduced with every required lane green - which is the defect the issue exists to close, silently re-openable. Verified at head bf77436e: `grep -rnF "Retro's push never carries the line" skills/ packages/ .github/` returns only the four instruction texts (skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md:390, skills/legion-retro/SKILL.md:175, packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/worker-common.md:19, packages/daemon/internal/prompts/roles/implementer.md:49) and the two generated mirror copies under packages/claude-envoy/legion/; no test file holds it. The repository already pins prompt wording in two suites, so the lock is in-convention, not a new habit: packages/pi-legion/src/skills-guard.test.ts:132-145 pins the `$'


skip-checks: true'` recipe's shape across the staged skills and packages/daemon/internal/prompts, and packages/daemon/internal/prompts/prompts_test.go:43 pins the clause about ending the head's message with the line as the last line preceded by two empty lines. Remedy: one assertion counting the sentence exactly once in each of the four files. packages/pi-legion/src/skills-guard.test.ts already reads promptsRoot directly (line 135), so a single test there covers all four; a per-file Go-side assertion in packages/daemon/internal/prompts is equally acceptable. It must read each file, never a composed prompt: the composed implementer prompt carries the sentence twice (worker-common.md plus the implementer role residue, measured in the implement handoff's second proof). The claude-envoy mirror needs no assertion of its own - packages/claude-envoy/tests/legion-plugin-fresh.test.ts already fails if the committed bundle drifts from its sources.

The `Size:` line reads `13 files changed, +358/-56`; GitHub reports 14 files, +407/-56 at head bf77436e (the tester's handoff added .legion/INFRA-149/test.json). Refresh it in the same push that carries the lock. Not round-gating.

verifiedAtHead.thermonuclear: Not run: the diff is 14 files of Markdown, JSON handoffs and the generated packages/claude-envoy/legion/ mirror, with no .go or .ts source. A docs-only diff gets no thermonuclear pair and no `Thermo` line (skill://legion-worker/references/pr-body.md).
verifiedAtHead.e2eLines: Both present in the body: `E2E (implementer)` (scratch PR sjawhar/legion#2132, heads 9f9b8346 and 0af01af0) and `E2E (tester)` (scratch PR sjawhar/legion#2144, heads 0e5bbdc7 and c4486ca8).

verifiedClaims: The daemon's behaviour is unchanged by this diff and the two sentences that now describe it are true of the code: packages/daemon/internal/classify/push.go:17-39 classifies a push as handoff-only from its changed paths alone and reads no commit message, and packages/daemon/internal/classify/decisions.go:59-76 records a settlement for the current head itself, so retro's deletion-only head both carries the code head's verdict by its paths and settles its own check runs - exactly what packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/architect-common.md:8 now states as two separate claims.

The reviewer's own four-read CI procedure is untouched by the diff: skills/legion-worker/references/merge-gate.md:27 and packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/reviewer.md:9 change only the parenthesis attributing the absence of a workflow run to the trailer line rather than to the paths. I ran all four reads at this head and they still work as written.

The instruction surface carries one rule: every hit of `grep -rn 'skip-checks\|trailer' skills/ packages/daemon/internal/prompts/` (26) read in context. The survivors that still mention paths are packages/daemon/internal/prompts/go/worker-common.md:21 and skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md's handoff clause, both scoped to the file-backed phases (planning, implementing, testing, reviewing), none of which is retro, and skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md:403-405, which is the daemon's path-keyed carry and is correct.

skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md is 498 lines, under the 500-line guard that packages/pi-legion/src/skills-guard.test.ts:39-41 enforces; the pi-legion and claude-envoy CI jobs are success at the code head, covering that guard and the mirror's fresh-generation test.
risks: Unmeasured: READY at a freshly pushed retro head. packages/daemon/internal/api/ready.go:173-184 refuses a required check whose result is classify.Missing with `its push may have skipped CI when it should not have; tell the architect`, and GitHub may not have created the head's check runs in the seconds between retro's push and the merger's READY. The refusal is transient and the pre-existing shape for every retro that writes a learning, so this change does not introduce it - but after this change every retro ends on a code head, so every issue now meets that window. Nothing in this pull request measures it.
